privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how SaaS Template collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use the website, software and services (collectively, the "Services"). It is placeholder text shipped with the template: replace it with your own policy before launching a real product.
By using the Services you consent to the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect the following categories of information:

items.label: Account information:
items.text: your name, email address and password, used to create and secure your account.

items.label: Profile information:
items.text: the profile picture you choose to upload.

items.label: Usage data:
items.text: how you interact with the Services, including the pages you visit.

items.label: Cookies:
items.text: we use cookies to maintain sessions and remember your language and theme preferences. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

items.label: Session logs:
items.text: your device, browser type and IP address, kept for security purposes such as reviewing the devices signed in to your account.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the collected information to:

items.text: provide, operate and improve the Services.
secure your account, verify your email address and prevent fraud or abuse.
communicate with you about your account and service updates.

sections.heading: Information sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with service providers that help us operate the Services, such as hosting and file storage, and we may disclose it when required to do so by law.

sections.heading: Security and retention
paragraphs: We use industry-standard measures, including encrypted password storage and token based authentication, to protect your information. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so please safeguard your credentials.
We retain your information for as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time from your account settings, or request deletion by contacting us at support@example.com.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of the Services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
If you have any questions about this policy or your data, contact us at support@example.com.
